_comment: TEST-DISCOVER pipeline output schema v3. Final instance: epics/<KEY>/<KEY>-discover.json (or shadow EpicDir). Single durable JSON only—no paired .md in v1. Do not persist secrets; do not store /temp/ path segments or raw credentials. discovery_status: complete requires obligation_closure.verifier_passed when emitting complete. v1/v2 instances remain readable; re-run TEST-DISCOVER to upgrade.
_discovery_status: complete | incomplete | aborted — complete only when obligation_closure.verifier_passed is true; generation complete also requires setup depth rules (see test-discover.md)

sources._fe_exploration_waived: true when fe_exploration_waived=yes on trigger after Phase 0b stop; caps dxtrade5/webbroker Chrome at shell_only.
sources._discover_run_started_at: ISO-8601 set once when Step A starts after Phase 0 pass; all validation_log.at must be >= this.
sources._cold_gate_resolved_at: Optional ISO-8601 when operator re-ran after TEST-DISCOVER … proceed and Phase 0 passed.
sources._crtqa_index_enabled: true when crtqa_index=yes on trigger OR discovery_mode is benchmark (both benchmark_suite and benchmark_attempt on line).

_obligation_ledger_item._evidence_need_values: ui | console | sql | api | pr | doc_only
_obligation_ledger_item.disposition: pending | affordance_mapped | fixture_need_mapped | prerequisite_mapped | tooling_blocked | scope_gap

_fixture_needs_item.notes: No Jira key; operator-facing gap text only

_prerequisite_edges_item.necessity: fixture | ladder | parity | settlement | instrument | unknown

_reference_index_item.key: CRTQA-xxxx or other linked QA/Test issue key
_reference_index_item._sanitized_command_hints_note: Use ["UNKNOWN"] when body yields no safe command tokens; never invent operational text.

_precondition_signals_note: Deprecated alias: when crtqa_index_enabled, copy reference_index[] here at emit for backward compatibility; MUST be [] in generation without crtqa_index.

environment.corner_platform_map_note: Resolve application_urls from docs/corner-platform-map.json (dxtrade retail root vs webbroker dealer path)—do not persist secrets.
environment._client_shell_impact_note: Snapshot from -ref.json client_shell_impact at Step A (status + note per shell only). Verifier uses adaptive.status for complete bar.

_delivery_issues_by_competency_item.competency: backend | frontend | contracts | infra | ops | unknown

issuetype_calibration.note: Record exact issuetype filters used after validating against one jira_search sample for the project.
issuetype_calibration.reference_index_note: Calibrate Test, Pre-Condition, QA Task, Test Execution only when crtqa_index_enabled (Step C-index).

_pr_code_map_item.competency: backend | frontend | contracts | infra | ops | unknown

_tooling_intent_levels: required | recommended | optional | skipped — Phase 0 cold probes for postgres_ctqa / crtqa_dx_console when required. When intent required and probe OK: postgres available + probe_pass; crtqa available + session_started true + handshake success. Forbidden: crtqa available + session_started false. Phase 0 fail: stop, no -discover.json. test_prep_gates.blocked per test-discover.md.

session_gates.note: No passwords stored here. pending_operator_session: crtqa_dx_console intent required but multiplex session state file absent at Phase 0 probe time—see playbook (path checked at runtime only; never stringify gitignored session paths in JSON). probe_required_operator: postgres intent required but MCP probe failed in Phase 0.

_operator_recovery_item.symptom: Short machine-readable probe outcome (no stack traces with secrets).
_operator_recovery_item.required_when_note: Why this gate applied (ties to tooling.intent required).
actions: Numbered operator steps; no secrets; no temp/ path segments in any string.

_fe_ui_sessions_note: Set in Phase 0c from Chrome post-login smoke—not from cred tokens alone. Values: not_required | waived | shell_only | authenticated. See docs/fe-ui-probe-contract.json.

_verification_affordances_item.competency: backend | frontend | contracts | infra | ops | unknown
_verification_affordances_item.evidence_grade: observed_runtime | observed_tool_transcript | fetched_from_issue | jira_pr_only | doc_only | unknown

exploration_budgets.note: Normative caps set by playbook execution.

test_prep_gates.override_token_doc: TEST-PREP trigger line token discover_override=yes when operator accepts proceeding despite test_prep_gates.blocked (see test-prep.md).
